new_scholarship.description: Western University's Office of the Registrar offers an unlimited number of Welcome to Canada Admission Scholarships to international students entering full-time first-year study at its main campus. Each award is worth $10,000 for the first year and includes a guaranteed place in on-campus residence for the first two years of study. Consideration is automatic on admission and no application is submitted. The award may not be combined with any other admission scholarship, although the New to Canada Grant is payable on top of it.
new_scholarship.best_fit: International students finishing secondary school outside Canada, or transferring into Western's main campus from a Canadian post-secondary institution, who are entering any first-entry undergraduate programme, are paying international tuition and fees, and can enrol full-time.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be international students who completed school outside of Canada or are transferring from a post-secondary institution within Canada; students who completed high school within Canada are not eligible. Applicants must apply for first-year full-time studies (minimum 3.5 courses) in any first-entry undergraduate programme at Western main campus for the 2026-27 Fall/Winter academic year, must be paying international student tuition and fees, must meet the admission conditions in their offer, and must not defer the award. Reducing enrolment to part-time or withdrawing from the academic year forfeits eligibility, and any change in Canadian status that qualifies the student for domestic fees after an offer renders them ineligible.

new_scholarship.notes: Chosen from several distinct international awards on the uwo.ca host. Western publishes an international entrance scholarship pool, three $100,000 International President's Entrance Scholarships, an $80,000 Neen Hodgins President's International Entrance Scholarship, and this Welcome to Canada Admission Scholarship. The Welcome to Canada Admission Scholarship was selected because it is the only one with its own dedicated official award page stating a precise, current benefit (CAD 10,000 first year plus a two-year residence guarantee), an explicit international-only eligibility rule, unlimited availability, and an explicit automatic-on-admission method - i.e. the best-documented award, not the highest-value one. No two records were produced for this host. Separately, the Automatic Admission Scholarships page publishes renewal conditions only for a former 'Western International Admission Scholarship' 'prior to the 2024-2025 academic year', indicating that named award was retired or renamed; no such award is claimed here. No renewal provision is published for the Welcome to Canada Admission Scholarship, which is stated as a first-year amount. This is a partial award: Western publishes an estimated year 1 international tuition and fees range of $48,000 to $64,400, so the $10,000 does not cover tuition. The University also publishes an international Tuition Fee Guarantee capping year-2-onward undergraduate international tuition increases at 4% per year.

Nursing applicants are told their English language requirements are different.

programme_detail_official.description: The Welcome to Canada Admission Scholarship is offered by Western University's Office of the Registrar as an unlimited number of awards for international students entering full-time first-year studies at Western's main campus. Each award provides CAD 10,000 for the first year and a guaranteed place in on-campus residence for the first two years of study. Consideration is automatic with the admission application and there is no separate application, no published academic-average threshold and no published selection weighting. The award cannot be combined with any other admission scholarship, although the New to Canada Grant is payable on top of it. It is not a tuition waiver: Western publishes an estimated year 1 international tuition and fees range of CAD 48,000 to 64,400.
programme_detail_official.coverage: Covers CAD 10,000 of first-year costs and guarantees on-campus residence for the first two years. It is not a tuition waiver, does not cover the balance of international tuition and fees, and cannot be combined with another admission scholarship.

application_readiness_checklist: Apply to Western through the OUAC portal for first-year study at the main campus, and make sure all supporting documentation is submitted, not just the application form
Confirm your study-permit and funding plan covers international fee-paying status, since any later switch to domestic fee status voids the award
Budget on the basis of international fees: Western estimates year 1 international tuition and fees at CAD 48,000 to CAD 64,400, so CAD 10,000 closes only a fraction of the gap
Sit an accepted English proficiency test early enough that the electronic score reaches Western before the University's stated March 2027 cut-off for fall 2027 entry
Match the first name, surname and date of birth on your test registration exactly to your OUAC application, or Western cannot match the score
Plan for the award to be visible on choose.uwo.ca by the end of April, and check the portal there rather than waiting for a separate email
Decide your residence plans knowing the award guarantees an on-campus place for the first two years
Do not count on stacking this with another Western admission scholarship; the two are mutually exclusive

Deferring admission, which the University states is not permitted for this award

Sending an English test score that does not match the OUAC personal details, so Western cannot match it
Applying to a part-time or non-first-entry programme rather than a first-entry undergraduate programme of at least 3.5 courses
Assuming the award renews. The published benefit is stated for the first year and no renewal provision is published

The residence guarantee secures a place, not a free place: the residence and meal plan is estimated at CAD 16,510 to CAD 19,140 for eight months and remains payable
Budget for the first year of study only. The published cash figure is for the first year and no renewal provision is published, so later years must be funded separately

alerts.trigger: Mutual exclusivity with other admission scholarships
alerts.message: The Welcome to Canada Admission Scholarship cannot be combined with any other admission scholarship. If you also hold or expect an offer of a Western Scholarship of Excellence, Western Scholarship of Distinction, Western Admission Scholarship, National Scholarship, Schulich Leader Scholarship, Continue in Canada Admission Scholarship or a Faculty of Arts & Humanities Entrance Scholarship, check which one Western will apply, because your fee account can only carry one.

The award is published as '$10,000 for first year' and Western publishes no renewal condition for it. Treat years two onward as unfunded unless the University states otherwise in writing for your entry year.
Do not wait for a scholarship deadline and do not submit a separate scholarship application. There is none. Check choose.uwo.ca by the end of April for the outcome.

For fall 2027 admission Western will not accept English tests written before 1 January 2025, and the test must be written before March 2027. A stale score can invalidate an otherwise complete application.

If anything changes your Canadian immigration status in a way that qualifies you for domestic tuition fees after the offer, Western states you become ineligible for this scholarship. Re-check after any permanent-residency application.

submission_workflow: Choose your Western programme and submit the undergraduate application through the Ontario Universities' Application Centre (OUAC), as international admissions at Western run through OUAC
Upload all supporting documentation to Western; the University requires the complete file, not only the application form

If English is not your first language, book IELTS Academic, TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency, CAEL or the Duolingo English Test early enough for the electronic result to arrive before the University's March cut-off for the entry year
Use the exact same first name, surname and date of birth on the test registration as on the OUAC application so Western can match the score

Watch for the To Do List item on your Western Student Center account; Western states proof of English proficiency may be requested there, and takes up to two weeks to update the item to 'Received' after a score arrives

If you believe you qualify for an English exemption or waiver, email welcome@uwo.ca with the subject 'English Proficiency Waiver Request' including your OUAC reference number or Western Student Number, and expect to complete an online form and upload transcripts and a school or teacher letter
After admission, monitor choose.uwo.ca from the end of April for the scholarship decision, then accept your offer of admission by the admission response deadline
Register full-time in first-year studies with at least 3.5 courses and pay international student tuition and fees, which is the condition for keeping the award
Note that admission scholarships cannot be deducted from the first installment of fees; Western applies them to the fee account once confirmed, typically before the end of September

research_notes.logo: Found in the header markup of Western's own prospective-student site welcome.uwo.ca (the anchor alt text is 'Western University'). Probed live with Invoke-WebRequest on 2026-10-03: HTTP 200, Content-Type 'image/svg+xml', 32554 bytes, and the body begins with an <svg> element rather than HTML, so it is real image bytes and not a WAF interstitial or error page. The bytes are served by www.uwo.ca, the University's own domain, so official_host is true and host_evidence is same_registrable_domain. Rule 6 checked explicitly by extracting fill attributes from the SVG: 25 paths use fill #4F2683 (Western purple) with only 2 white knock-out counters inside the crest and 1 'none', so this is a dark variant that stays visible on a light card, not a white-on-transparent wordmark. The 'd-' filename prefix denotes the dark variant, which is consistent with it being used in the site header on white backgrounds. Two alternatives were probed and rejected: https://www.uwo.ca/img/homepage/2017/logo-western-crest-ftr.svg (HTTP 200, image/svg+xml, 15246 bytes, but the 'ftr' footer file carries no fill attributes so its colour could not be verified dark, and the footer variant is more likely the light-on-purple one) and https://www.uwo.ca/web_standards/2025-global/assets/img/logos/d-western-logo-footer.svg (HTTP 200, image/svg+xml, 31794 bytes, but it is the footer-set variant rather than the primary mark). No third-party, aggregator, CDN or Wikimedia source was used.

research_notes.degree_level_confirmed: The award page states eligibility for 'first year full-time studies (minimum of 3.5 courses) in any first-entry undergraduate program at Western Main Campus for the 2026-27 Fall/Winter academic year', which is bachelor's-level study. Corroborated by Western's Find Your Admission Requirements page, which places this within first-year undergraduate admission.
research_notes.award_selection_rationale: The uwo.ca host carries several distinct international undergraduate awards: the general international entrance scholarship pool, three $100,000 International President's Entrance Scholarships, an $80,000 Neen Hodgins President's International Entrance Scholarship, and the Welcome to Canada Admission Scholarship. Only the Welcome to Canada Admission Scholarship has a dedicated official award page that states a current precise benefit (CAD 10,000 for first year plus a guaranteed on-campus residence place for the first two years), an explicit international-only eligibility rule, unlimited availability, and an explicit automatic-on-admission application method. The National Scholarship Program's international awards are documented inside a programme aimed mainly at Canadian citizens and permanent residents, so their international figures are less cleanly documented on their own. The Welcome to Canada Admission Scholarship was therefore chosen as the best-documented bachelor's-level international award on this host, and it is the only record produced for uwo.ca.
